document: Master of Arts in New Media at Aalto University (2012-2014). Studied 3D modeling and animation, audiovisual studies, spatial interaction design, installations, robotics, electronics and embedded technologies, sound design, software studies and game design, and programming. Thesis: Tooling software for software companies — classification of tools for specific purposes.
